entries.title: Psalms 80:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician, set to aShoshanim Eduth.. A Psalm of Asaph.>> Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, Thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; Thou that  sittest [above] the cherubim, shine forth.

entries.title: Psalms 80:2
segments: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up thy might, And come to save us.

entries.title: Psalms 80:3
segments: Turn us again, O God; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

entries.title: Psalms 80:4
segments: O Jehovah God of hosts, How long  wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

entries.title: Psalms 80:5
segments: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in large measure.

entries.title: Psalms 80:6
segments: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbors; And our enemies laugh among themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 80:7
segments: Turn us again, O God of hosts; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

entries.title: Psalms 80:8
segments: Thou broughtest a vine out of Egypt: Thou didst drive out the nations, and plantedst it.

entries.title: Psalms 80:9
segments: Thou preparedst [room] before it, And it took deep root, and filled the land.

entries.title: Psalms 80:10
segments: The mountains were covered with the shadow of it, And  the boughs thereof were [like]  cedars of God.

entries.title: Psalms 80:11
segments: It sent out its branches unto the sea, And its shoots unto the River.

entries.title: Psalms 80:12
segments: Why hast thou broken down its walls, So that all they that pass by the way do pluck it?

entries.title: Psalms 80:13
segments: The boar out of the wood doth ravage it, And the wild beasts of the field feed on it.

entries.title: Psalms 80:14
segments: Turn again, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: Look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine,

entries.title: Psalms 80:15
segments: And  the stock which thy right hand planted, And the  branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

entries.title: Psalms 80:16
segments: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: They perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 80:17
segments: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, Upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

entries.title: Psalms 80:18
segments: So shall we not go back from thee: Quicken thou us, and we will call upon thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 80:19
segments: Turn us again, O Jehovah God of hosts; Cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
